info.title: ros2net
info.description: ros2net: the ROS2.Net command-line tool. topic/node/service/action/param/interface/bag/security/doctor commands that mirror the ros2 CLI, without a ROS 2 installation (RTPS, rosbridge or in-process middleware).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
ros2net — the ROS2.Net command-line tool (made by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil).
Works without a ROS 2 installation: talks DDS-RTPS, rosbridge or the in-process middleware.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --rmw
options.description: Middleware: rtps (default, talks to ROS 2 DDS networks), rosbridge or inprocess. Defaults to ROS2NET_RMW.

options.name: --domain
options.description: ROS domain id (defaults to ROS_DOMAIN_ID, else 0).

options.name: --url
options.description: rosbridge WebSocket URL (implies --rmw rosbridge), e.g. ws://robot:9090.

options.name: --localhost
options.description: Restrict discovery to this machine. [default: False]

options.name: --spin-time
options.description: Seconds to wait for discovery before reading the graph (default: 2 for rtps, 1 for rosbridge, 0 in-process).

options.name: --show-types
options.description: Show topic types. [default: False]

options.name: --count-topics
options.description: Only print the number of topics. [default: False]

options.name: --include-hidden-topics
options.description: Include hidden topics. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print endpoint details (node, GID, QoS). [default: False]

options.name: --once
options.description: Print the first message and exit. [default: False]

options.name: --times
options.description: Exit after N messages.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print each message as one line of JSON. [default: False]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Give up after this many seconds.

options.name: --qos-profile
options.description: default | sensor_data | services_default | parameters | system_default | latched

options.name: --qos-reliability
options.description: reliable | best_effort

options.name: --qos-durability
options.description: volatile | transient_local

options.name: --qos-depth
options.description: History depth (keep last).

arguments.name: MESSAGE_TYPE
arguments.description: Type, e.g. std_msgs/msg/String (discovered from the graph when omitted).

options.name: --rate
options.description: Publishing rate in Hz. [default: 1]

options.name: --once
options.description: Publish one message and exit. [default: False]

options.name: --times
options.description: Publish N messages and exit.

options.name: --wait-matching
options.description: Seconds to wait for a subscription before the first publish. [default: 1]

options.name: --qos-profile
options.description: default | sensor_data | services_default | parameters | system_default | latched

options.name: --qos-reliability
options.description: reliable | best_effort

options.name: --qos-durability
options.description: volatile | transient_local

options.name: --qos-depth
options.description: History depth (keep last).

arguments.name: VALUES
arguments.description: Message as YAML or JSON, e.g. "{linear: {x: 0.5}}".

commands.name: hz
commands.description: Print the average publishing rate of a topic.

options.name: --window
options.description: Window size in messages. [default: 10000]

options.name: --duration
options.description: Stop after this many seconds.

options.name: --qos-profile
options.description: default | sensor_data | services_default | parameters | system_default | latched

options.name: --qos-reliability
options.description: reliable | best_effort

options.name: --qos-durability
options.description: volatile | transient_local

options.name: --qos-depth
options.description: History depth (keep last).

commands.name: bw
commands.description: Print the bandwidth used by a topic.

options.name: --window
options.description: Window size in messages. [default: 10000]

options.name: --duration
options.description: Stop after this many seconds.

options.name: --qos-profile
options.description: default | sensor_data | services_default | parameters | system_default | latched

options.name: --qos-reliability
options.description: reliable | best_effort

options.name: --qos-durability
options.description: volatile | transient_local

options.name: --qos-depth
options.description: History depth (keep last).

options.name: --all
options.description: Include hidden nodes (names starting with '_'). [default: False]

options.name: --count-nodes
options.description: Only print the number of nodes. [default: False]

commands.name: info
commands.description: Print the publishers, subscriptions, services and actions of a node.

options.name: --show-types
options.description: Show service types. [default: False]

options.name: --include-hidden-services
options.description: Include hidden services. [default: False]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait for the service and the response. [default: 10]

commands.name: action
commands.description: Inspect and send goals to actions.

options.name: --show-types
options.description: Show action types. [default: False]

commands.name: send_goal
commands.description: Send a goal and wait for the result.

options.name: --feedback
options.description: Print feedback messages. [default: False]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait for the action server. [default: 10]

commands.name: param
commands.description: Get, set, list, dump and load parameters of other nodes.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait for the node's parameter services. [default: 5]

arguments.name: NODE_NAME
arguments.description: Node to list; all nodes when omitted.

commands.name: dump
commands.description: Print all parameters of a node as a ROS 2 parameter file.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write to a file instead of stdout.

commands.name: load
commands.description: Load parameters from a ROS 2 parameter file.

commands.name: interface
commands.description: Show and generate ROS 2 interface types.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List interface types known to ros2net.

commands.name: package
commands.description: List the interfaces of a package.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate C# sources from interface files (no source generator needed).

options.name: --output
options.description: Folder for the generated .cs files. [default: Generated]

options.name: --root-namespace
options.description: Root namespace of generated packages. [default: ROS2.Net.Msgs]

commands.name: bag
commands.description: Record, play, inspect and export rosbag2 MCAP bags.

options.name: --all
options.description: Record all topics. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Bag directory (default rosbag2_<timestamp>).

options.name: --regex
options.description: Record topics matching this regular expression.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Exclude topics matching this regular expression.

options.name: --compression
options.description: none | zstd | lz4 (MCAP chunk compression). [default: none]

options.name: --max-bag-size
options.description: Split files at this many bytes (0 = no split).

options.name: --max-bag-duration
options.description: Split files after this many seconds.

options.name: --duration
options.description: Stop recording after this many seconds.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace an existing bag directory. [default: False]

options.name: --rate
options.description: Playback speed factor. [default: 1]

options.name: --loop
options.description: Loop playback. [default: False]

options.name: --topics
options.description: Only play these topics.

options.name: --remap
options.description: Remap topics: old:=new.

options.name: --clock
options.description: Publish /clock at this rate in Hz (e.g. 100).

options.name: --start-offset
options.description: Start this many seconds into the bag.

options.name: --delay
options.description: Seconds to wait (for discovery) before playing. [default: 0.5]

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export messages as JSON Lines or CSV (datasets for AI training).

options.name: --format
options.description: jsonl | csv [default: jsonl]

options.name: --topic
options.description: Topic(s) to export (csv needs exactly one).

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file (stdout when omitted).

commands.name: create_enclave
commands.description: Create an enclave (identity + permissions) in a keystore.

commands.name: list_enclaves
commands.description: List the enclaves of a keystore.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the environment: runtime, middlewares, network, multicast, native library.

options.name: --report
options.description: Print the full report including network interfaces. [default: False]

commands.name: run-demo
commands.description: Run a built-in demo node (like ros2 run demo_nodes_cpp ...).

options.name: --duration
options.description: Stop after this many seconds.
